exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha o que a pessoa disse.
exercise.listen: I've never been to Europe, but I went to Mexico last year with some friends.
options: Ela já foi à Europa e ao México.
Ela nunca foi à Europa, mas foi ao México no ano passado.
Ela vai ao México no ano que vem.
exercise.explanation_pt: "I've never been to Europe" = nunca fui à Europa; "I went to Mexico last year" = fui ao México no ano passado.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça a reclamação e escolha o que o cliente quer.
exercise.listen: The heater in my room has been broken since we arrived. I'd like to change rooms, please.
options: Quer um aquecedor novo para levar para casa.
exercise.explanation_pt: "I'd like to change rooms" = gostaria de trocar de quarto.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça a história e escolha o que aconteceu.
exercise.listen: I was jogging in the park when it started to rain, so I ran into a café. It turned out that my old teacher was sitting there.
options: Ela encontrou uma antiga professora num café.
Ela estava num café quando começou a correr.
Ela correu na chuva até em casa.
exercise.explanation_pt: "It turned out that my old teacher was sitting there" = acabou que minha antiga professora estava sentada lá.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça e dê um conselho: a pessoa deveria dormir mais cedo.
exercise.listen: I'm always tired at work. What should I do?
accepted: You should go to bed earlier
You should sleep earlier
Maybe you should go to bed earlier
I think you should go to bed earlier
Why don't you go to bed earlier
If I were you, I'd go to bed earlier
You'd better go to bed earlier
You should get more sleep

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "should" vem o verbo direto, sem "to".
commonErrors.correction_en: You should go to bed earlier.
You should go to bed earlier.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que você também não gosta.
exercise.listen: I don't like working on weekends.
accepted: Neither do I
Me neither
Nor do I
I don't either
I don't like it either
Me neither. It's terrible

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para concordar com uma frase negativa use "Me neither" ou "Neither do I".

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu trabalho como professora há quatro anos."
accepted: I've been working as a teacher for four years
I have been working as a teacher for four years
I've worked as a teacher for four years
I have worked as a teacher for four years
I've been a teacher for four years
I have been a teacher for four years

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Trabalho há quatro anos" usa o present perfect: "I've been working... for four years".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've been working as a teacher for four years.
I've been working as a teacher for four years.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Você pode me emprestar seu carregador?"
accepted: Can you lend me your charger
Could you lend me your charger
Can I borrow your charger
Could I borrow your charger
Can you lend me your charger, please
Could I borrow your charger, please

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Borrow" é pegar emprestado. Use "lend me" ou "Can I borrow...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Can you lend me your charger?

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu concordo com você, mas é caro demais."
accepted: I agree with you, but it's too expensive
I agree with you, but it is too expensive
I agree, but it's too expensive
I agree with you, but it's way too expensive

commonErrors.correction_en: I agree with you, but it's too expensive.
I agree with you, but it's too expensive.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu costumava jogar futebol, mas não jogo mais."
accepted: I used to play soccer, but I don't anymore
I used to play football, but I don't anymore
I used to play soccer, but not anymore
I used to play soccer, but I don't play anymore
I used to play football, but I don't play anymore

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Não mais" é "not anymore" ou "I don't anymore".
commonErrors.correction_en: I used to play soccer, but I don't anymore.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Hábito do passado é "used to", com "-d".
commonErrors.correction_en: I used to play soccer, but I don't anymore.

exercise.instruction_pt: Responda como num small talk com um colega, por cerca de 30 segundos.
exercise.prompt_en: Hey! How was your weekend? Did you do anything interesting?
guidelines_pt: Responda no passado com pelo menos dois detalhes (onde, com quem, como foi).
Use pelo menos um conector: "First", "Then", "In the end".

exercise.instruction_pt: Ligue cada palavra ao significado.
Como se diz "Eu assisti à série inteira"?
exercise.explanation_pt: Assistir é "watch". "Assist" é ajudar e "attend" é comparecer.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ligue cada palavra ao significado.
Qual palavra significa "jornal"?
exercise.explanation_pt: Jornal é "newspaper". "Journal" é diário ou revista acadêmica, e "notice" é aviso.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ligue cada expressão ao significado.
Complete com o verbo certo.
accepted: saw
watched

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com tempo definido ("last Saturday") use o passado simples: "I saw".
commonErrors.correction_en: I saw that movie last Saturday.

exercise.instruction_pt: Complete com a forma certa de "not / recycle".
exercise.sentence: If we ___ more, the landfills will be full in ten years.
accepted: don't recycle
do not recycle

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "if" vem o presente: "If we don't recycle".
commonErrors.correction_en: If we don't recycle more, the landfills will be full in ten years.

exercise.instruction_pt: Complete com "was" ou "were".
exercise.sentence: The new hospital ___ opened by the mayor yesterday.
accepted: was

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Sujeito singular no passado, na voz passiva: "was opened".
commonErrors.correction_en: The new hospital was opened by the mayor yesterday.

exercise.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: I was driving to work when I saw the accident.

exercise.instruction_pt: Qual frase está correta?
options: If I am you, I will talk to her.
If I were you, I'd talk to her.
If I were you, I will talk to her.
exercise.explanation_pt: Conselho com situação imaginária: "If I were you, I'd (would)...".
